reviews.comment: Sczepanski is probably your best option for ochem prof. He does go through lecture material fast so pay attention in class. Annotated lecture slides are posted at the end of each chapter. He gives  info about what will or won't be on exams in class that he doesn't write down on the slides so it's just beneficial to go to class. TAKE THIS PROF!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Sczepanski is an effective and caring professor. Initially the class can be daunting, but there is no other professor more efficient in teaching the language and topics of ochem, and if you go to every lecture and study outside of class (which if you don't why are you in college?) you should make a good grade. Homework is eh but its pretty easy
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was one of the better professors I have taken for chemistry. He explains topics well and is available outside of class. Homework is only 10% which means that the 4 exams you take make up 90% of the whole grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you pay attention to lectures, he's an incredible professor. He explains concepts very clearly and is very accessable outside of class. He posts slides beforehand, and goes through and notates on them during the lecture, which he then posts. Only downside is that ~90% of your entire final grade is just exams
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor!!! Explains things very clearly and teaches everything you need to know on the tests in class. Very clear lectures and powerpoints. Tests are fair.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He explained all the material thoroughly and in a way that helped me understand it well. It's recommended to read the textbook. As the semester went on I did less work outside of class, which is the only reason I got a B. He gave a slight curve at the end. Although tests make up almost your whole grade, they're very fair content-wise.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Sczepanski is one of the best profs I've had at A&M. Ochem is a hard class but he is your best bet if you want to succeed. His lectures are organized and he tells you exactly what you need to know. It requires a lot of outside work in addition to attending lecture and paying attention.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was by no means easy and grade is dependent entirely on tests, however he is an amazing professor. His lectures were very informative and I felt like I learned a lot.

reviews.comment: Class was very hard. Practice tests were five years old and irrelevant. Uses OWL for homework, but those problems are not reflected in the exams. reviews.comment: He is very organized and caring. All his lectures were very informative. Great prof overall.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Sczepanski is my favorite professor by far. His lectures are clear and able to understand. He never rushes the material and gives you a clear understanding of what you need to know for exams. He makes his test a lot like the lectures and answers all questions. He is very calm and collected when teaching which makes the material less stressful.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Very organized and knowledgable. It's a hard class but he's probably your best bet at tamu. He's a great prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: You definitely have to work hard to earn a good grade in the end. OWL homework is a must. It might've been the online format, but he couldn't make up his mind about the format of his tests and would never tell us until 2 days before. Hopefully this changed. He curved in the end, but I felt he never really had answers to our questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: OChem can definitely be a challenging class, but he did everything he could to make it easier. Never quite managed to make the tests like the reviews, but allowed us open note, so I never worried too much about it. Nothing was assigned from the textbook, but it was definitely helpful, as he taught pretty much what was in it.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Everyone knows that ochem is hard, but I don't think Sczepanski did much to help us out. His teaching style did not work well for me, especially in an online format. The final grade was 3 tests, final, and homework. No feedback was given on exams (like why points were taken off) and there was not a key for practice exams. Nice dude but not for me.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Although it was online as long as you tried youd be fine. I get that the main issues is staying motivated but at the end of the day thats on you as harsh as that sounds. Ochem is just memorization and nothing more as long as you put in the effort (it is a hard class for sure) youll be fine its not as scary as it sounds and this prof was amazing

reviews.comment: His teaching style just wasn't for me, especially through zoom. Never knew what the test was going to be like, format of tests changed every time. Seldom gives extra credit. No key to practice exam. I just hope he's a better teacher in person...

reviews.comment: I am so glad he was my ochem professor: he is very passionate about chemistry & a good lecturer. Highly recommend going to SI sessions (they help GREATLY). His exams are very reasonable (but there's always 1 question that we have never ever seen before). Ochem is tough so don't procrastinate. Tips for an A: attend SI, lecture, do practice problems.

reviews.comment: Great prof. Very clear on what he wants you to know
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very good teaching style. He takes his time and writes everything on the board. Most of the students that did not do well in this class are the ones who waited until last minute to study or do homework. To do well in this class just go to lecture and don't procrastinate. He is available to help if needed.

reviews.comment: Dr. sczepanski is the best professor I have ever had. He really is interested in his students and cares about there learning. He has a caring, compassionate heart and will help you succeed if you try.

The best part about this prof. is his teaching style. Instead of using powerpoint presentations, every definition and reaction was clearly written out on the board and explained as he went along. Go to class, take notes, read the textbook, make flashcards, and study all reaction mechanisms to be successful. This was a great prof!
